name: s1-pear-v2-harness
description: Spike S1: can a pre-v3 Pear platform still be bootstrapped, held, and run pear:// apps. Runs only in a throwaway VM. overrides pin hypercore to Pear v2.6.5's own 11.28.1 (hypercore-storage 2.x): a corestore written by today's hypercore-storage 3.x is one the v2.6.5 sidecar refuses.
